# bad-sdk-worker

A small worker. The rendered quickstart binds the worker handle to a non-canonical variable name.

## Install

```bash
iii worker add bad-sdk-worker
```

`iii worker add` fetches the binary, writes a config block into the engine's `config.yaml`, and the engine starts the worker on the next `iii worker start`.

## Quickstart

```rust
use iii_sdk::{register_worker, InitOptions};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let iii = register_worker("ws://localhost:49134", InitOptions::default());
    let _ = iii;
    Ok(())
}
```
